# Webphone

> Auto-generated catalog summary for LLM consumption.

## Webphone (webphone)
Single-binary unified-communications web app for pbx.artmann.tech: SIP calls (SIP.js island), SMS/MMS threads, fax, voicemail, history and contacts behind one login against the PBX directory.

### Events
- Message Received (v1.0.0) [sends]: An inbound message landed in an owner's thread.
- Message Delivery Advanced (v1.0.0) [sends]: An outbound message's delivery state moved: send accepted or refused, provider verdict landed.
- Thread Flag Changed (v1.0.0) [sends]: The user toggled a thread organization flag; list-only by design, so an open transcript is never wiped.
- Fax Advanced (v1.0.0) [sends]: A fax job moved through its lifecycle: submit, settle, verdict, or receive.

## User: Lars Artmann (lars)

## Domain: Telephony (telephony)
User-facing telephony for pbx.artmann.tech: calls, message threads, and fax per extension, live over SSE.
Services: webphone
